annotation.bound_parties_text: The Regulations prescribe the minimum age (18 years) a person must have attained to be issued a certificate of registration as a small unmanned aircraft operator.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: the age which a person must have attained to be issued with a certificate of registration as a small unmanned aircraft operator
annotation.dates_quote: These Regulations may be cited as the Air Navigation (Minimum Age for Operators of Small Unmanned Aircraft) Regulations 2019 and come into force on 1st October 2019.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: The Air Navigation (Minimum Age for Operators of Small Unmanned Aircraft) Regulations 2019
